name: Interest Rate Derivative 2 Choice
definition: Choice element specifying the underlying types of an interest rate derivative.

SwapRelated.name: Swap Related
SwapRelated.definition: Underlying interest rate type is a swap, swaption, a future on a swap or a forward on a swap with regard to the underlying swap.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Where contract type is different from swaps, swaptions, futures on swaps and forwards on a swap, this field is used.
